annotations.title: Citation generator (DOI or title to APA, MLA, Chicago, BibTeX)

description: Citation generator (DOI or title to APA, MLA, Chicago, BibTeX) — Turn a DOI (doi=10.1038/nature14539 or a doi.org URL) or a title/reference string (q=) into ready-to-paste citations: APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago author-date, Harvard, IEEE, BibTeX and RIS, plus in-text forms. Uses Crossref metadata (journal articles, books, chapters, proceedings, reports, preprints): authors, year, journal, volume, issue, pages, publisher, ISSN/ISBN, cited-by count and license. q= returns the best match with a confidence score and alternatives; style= limits output to one format. Warns about missing fields and update/retraction notices. Abstracts are not returned. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: research_cite
